WITH s AS (SELECT f.sale_date, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND st.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s) fact_store_days, (SELECT count(*) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900) rpt_store_days,
 (SELECT sum(net) FROM s) fact_net, (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND store_id<900) rpt_net,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load t WHERE t.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load t JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id) WHERE t.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22') stg_in_fact,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN st.valid_from AND st.valid_to) store_ver_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND net_amount<=0) nonpos,
 (SELECT max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line) max_ret, (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale

WITH sold AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, st.format, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.net_amount, f.quantity
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st USING(store_key)
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'),
ret AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty_ret, count(*) n, max(return_date) maxd, min(return_date) mind FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.format, s.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, count(r.sales_line_id) ret_lines, sum(s.net_amount) sold_net, sum(r.refund_net) ref_net, sum(s.quantity) qty, sum(r.qty_ret) qty_ret,
 round(100*sum(r.refund_net)/sum(s.net_amount),3) val_rate, round(100.0*sum(r.qty_ret)/sum(s.quantity),3) unit_rate, round(100.0*count(r.sales_line_id)/count(*),3) line_rate,
 min(r.mind) mind, max(r.maxd) maxd
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT round(r.refund_net/(f.net_amount*r.quantity_returned/f.quantity),2) ratio_bucket, count(*) n, 
 sum(CASE WHEN r.vat_rate<>f.vat_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) vat_mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net*(1+r.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gross_inconsistent,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.store_key<>f.store_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_store
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING(sales_line_id)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH returned AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) AS refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY sales_line_id)
SELECT st.format AS store_format,
       round(100 * sum(coalesce(r.refund_net, 0)) / sum(f.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN returned r ON r.sales_line_id = f.sales_line_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
  AND st.store_id < 900
GROUP BY st.format
ORDER BY CASE st.format WHEN 'Small' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
